statements.t: Both are happening at once, and we raised our outlook for the second time this year.
A webcast and conference call to discuss the Company’s results will be held today, November 5, 2026, beginning at 5:00 p.m.

The Company is unable to provide a comparable FY 2026 outlook for, or a reconciliation to net income because it cannot provide a meaningful or accurate calculation or estimation of certain reconciling items without unreasonable effort.
